**Quick One‑Pan Chicken & Veggie Stir‑Fry**

Ingredients (serves 2):  
- 2 boneless skinless chicken thighs, sliced thin  
- 1 cup broccoli florets  
- 1 red bell pepper, sliced  
- ½ cup snap peas  
- 2 tbsp soy sauce  
- 1 tbsp oyster sauce  
- 1 tsp sesame oil  
- 1 clove garlic, minced  
- ½ tsp ginger, grated  
- 1 tbsp olive oil  
- Cooked rice or noodles  

Method: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium‑high heat. Add chicken, stir‑fry 3‑4 min until browned. Push to side, add garlic & ginger, cook 30 s. Toss in veggies, stir‑fry 3‑4 min until crisp‑tender. Stir in soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil; coat everything and heat through 1 min. Serve over rice or noodles.
